headline: Sensex Surges 898 Points and Nifty Reclaims 25,800 Driven by Banking Stocks and FPI Inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) inflows and a rally in the Indian rupee.
Cooling crude oil prices boosting domestic market sentiment.
Robust buying in banking and IT stocks, leading NIFTY Bank to a record high.
Indian markets bucking global weakness caused by an overseas selloff in AI and chip stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 898 points while Nifty climbed back above the 25,800 mark.
Indian markets registered a 2.6% gain overall despite early weakness in the trading session.
TrueRE Oriana Power announced an investment of ₹750 crore in five compressed biogas projects.
Mahindra Last Mile announced a focus on domestic battery cells to enhance EV economics.
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp recovery as the Sensex rallied 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800, led by banking and IT stocks. The domestic market bucked global weakness, supported by FPI inflows, rupee strength, and lower crude oil prices. In corporate highlights, Oriana Power planned a ₹750 crore biogas expansion while Mahindra Last Mile focused on battery localization.
